messages.text:
Create a new workflow rule about naming of the PRs.

Name them:

"Magnet System: <description>"
"Tracker: <description>"
"Calorimeter: <description>"
"Muon System: ..."
"Global: " (e.g. envelope design)
"Software: " (to have new software skills)
"Infrastructure: " (like this one)

Record this rule and apply it to open PRs, also - if there are conflicts - try to resolve them, they are mostly in the logging files, where accepting both changes is the default.
I’ll record the naming rule, rename the open PRs, and check for merge conflicts. For logging conflicts, I’ll preserve both records where they can be combined consistently.

Four PRs are open. I’ll use `Magnet System` for #6, `Tracker` for #8 and #13, and `Software` for #14. Only #8 currently conflicts with `main`, in the documentation index and project tracking/review records. I’ll preserve both branches’ entries and reconcile those records by stable ID.

The new `Infrastructure:` prefix replaces the old `chore:` naming convention. I’ll update the CI check so maintenance keeps its existing exclusion from scientific progress tracking.

The four existing PRs have been renamed. I’ve also pushed the conflict-resolution merge to #8: both branches’ records are retained, the pixel design and review targets are unchanged, and all 40 tests for that branch pass.

The naming rule and CI update are ready. I’m finishing their checks before opening the infrastructure PR.

[PR #15](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/15) is open with the naming rule, documentation updates and CI enforcement. All five open PRs are now mergeable. The four existing PRs have their new titles, and #8’s conflict resolution is published.

The naming change passed 41 Python tests, the dashboard build and 14 JavaScript assertions. I’m completing the session record; GitHub CI is running.

Created [PR #15 — Infrastructure: Standardize PR naming and conflict preservation](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/15).

- Recorded all seven prefixes and added CI enforcement.
- Renamed open PRs #6, #8, #13 and #14.
- Resolved #8’s conflicts, preserving both branches’ records and unchanged review history.
- All open PRs are mergeable.

Local tests, logging validation and dashboard builds passed. GitHub CI is queued.
